subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: What source-reply delivery policy should OpenClaw enforce for channel sessions when an assistant emits ordinary text before or between tool calls?
rationale: Current behavior is partly product policy, partly security boundary: fixing the leak may require changing defaults or adding stricter guards that affect existing users who rely on automatic bare-text replies.

options.title: Preserve automatic finals, suppress internals
options.body: Keep automatic final replies as the default but add runtime guards so pre-tool, inter-tool, reasoning, commentary, and NO_REPLY-suppressed blocks cannot become channel-visible payloads.

options.title: Move channels to message-tool-only
options.body: Require message(action=send) for more source/channel scopes by default, with migration, docs, and fallback handling for users whose agents only produce final text.

options.title: Only ship opt-in mitigations
options.body: Keep defaults unchanged and land opt-in tools such as final-tag enforcement or message-tool mode, accepting that the default leak class remains possible.

recommendation.title: Preserve automatic finals, suppress internals
recommendation.body: Keep automatic final replies as the default but add runtime guards so pre-tool, inter-tool, reasoning, commentary, and NO_REPLY-suppressed blocks cannot become channel-visible payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a compatibility-sensitive product/security boundary decision on the source-reply path, and steipete is the clearest recent reviewer/source-history routing signal from the current checkout and issue timeline.
